subject: Evaluation commissioning checklist & success storyboard
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@curewell.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 17:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation commissioning checklist & success storyboard

Thanks for the kickoff pack, Soojin — this looks promising. A couple of clarifying questions from our side before we finalize the MAP: 

1) Success metric weighting: Can you confirm the proposed split between latency (P95 under load), extraction accuracy (entity-level F1), and production stability (uptime)? We need to show this to our clinical ops lead.
2) Acceptance tests: Can you add a short definition of the smoke test that we run after each deploy during the pilot week? Specifically, what sample set and pass thresholds are you using?
3) Audit evidence: Our security team needs the SOC2 excerpt you referenced — can you attach the specific section about logging and data retention?

If we can align on those 3 items today, we should be able to sign off on the MAP and schedule the first integration sprint next Monday.

—Daniel
Senior PM, CureWell Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@curewell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 18:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation commissioning checklist & success storyboard

Daniel — thanks, good questions. Short responses inline, then an updated attachment attached (rw_map_v1.xlsx) that maps each acceptance test to owners and evidence.

1) Success metric weighting (proposed):
- Latency (P95 under pilot load): 35%
- Extraction accuracy (entity-level F1 on curated clinical set): 45%
- Production stability (uptime / successful requests): 20%
Rationale: we prioritize correctness for the evaluation, with latency as a secondary business constraint. We can rebalance if you need stronger latency guarantees.

2) Acceptance tests (summary):
- Smoke: 50 representative clinical notes (sampled across three specialties) — end-to-end inference with golden labels; pass = >= 90% of notes return with no errors and model returns structured output for >= 95% of test items.
- Regression: full run of 2k anonymized notes (off-line) — entity F1 >= 0.78 versus baseline.
- Canary: 1% live traffic split for 48 hours with end-to-end monitoring (latency P95 < 900ms, error rate < 0.5%).

3) SOC2 excerpt: attaching SOC2-evidence.pdf with logging section pages called out in the workbook. The short summary in the workbook shows where our audit artifacts live; the SOC2 PDF contains the retention and logging scope.

Next steps I propose: we lock the MAP today, run the smoke set on Friday, and start the integration sprint Monday. If that works, Ben will own the canary orchestration and Evelyn will coordinate evidence and sign-off artifacts.

Thanks — Soojin
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rw_map_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), SOC2-evidence.pdf (audit excerpt)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@curewell.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation commissioning checklist & success storyboard

Looping in operational detail. Per Soojin's workbook, I'm taking these owners:
- Canary orchestration & metrics dashboard: Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Evidence collection & compliance sign-off: Evelyn Hart (Redwood) + CureWell security contact
- Integration sprint plan & test harness: CureWell infra team + Redwood infra (we'll provide a terraform module)

Quick clarifications on acceptance test mechanics: 
- Smoke set: we'll provide a CLI that runs the 50-note sample against the evaluation endpoint and emits a pass/fail CSV. CureWell will provide the golden labels via the Drive link.
- Regression: Redwood will run the 2k offline run in a pre-prod job and share the report and raw outputs for your QA.
- Canary: we'll ship an automated rollback policy if error rate crosses 1% for 5 consecutive minutes. Canary duration is configurable but we suggest 48 hours as Soojin called out.

I'll spin up the dashboard (Prometheus/Grafana) this afternoon; link will be in the MAP workbook under "observability".

—Ben
Director, Customer Reliability

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@curewell.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation commissioning checklist & success storyboard

Thanks everyone — green to proceed on the proposed plan. Two minor asks before we lock: 

- Please include a short decision rule for partial pass / conditional acceptance (e.g., if entity F1 is between 0.75 and 0.78 we do a 2-week remediation sprint rather than failing the evaluation outright).
- Add a confirmation that data retention during the pilot is 30 days and that logs are exportable for audit on request (we saw that in the SOC2 PDF but want it explicit in the MAP).

If you add those two bullets and share the final workbook I will route to our legal + procurement for signature. Target: sign-off by Friday EOD and sprint start Monday.

—Daniel
Senior PM, CureWell Health
